title: How to calculate the range (max minus min)
task: The spread of a data set — highest value minus lowest. A one-number measure of variability.

excel.note: Conditional range: =MAXIFS(...)-MINIFS(...). For range ignoring outliers, see percentile-based spread.

explanation: The statistical range is simply the largest value minus the smallest: 45 - 7 = 38. It's the quickest gauge of how spread out numbers are, but it only sees the two extremes, so a single outlier dominates it — for a sturdier spread use standard deviation or the interquartile range (QUARTILE(...,3)-QUARTILE(...,1)). For a range within categories, swap in MAXIFS and MINIFS with your condition.
